description: What a typical hotel room costs on a night in Las Vegas (26 Strip resorts) or Miami (23 Miami Beach, Brickell and Downtown hotels), from the Points or Cash Hotel Price Indexes: the panel median, how many were sold out, and the multiple against a quiet night checked about as far ahead (named with its own date), with the events on that night and their own dates, the as_of date and the page link. Ask by date (YYYY-MM-DD), a date range, or an event name (e.g. "re:Invent", "Art Basel", "CES", "New Year"). Use it first for any question about what hotels cost on an event night or a big night in Vegas or Miami, or how a night compares with a normal one; it is our own dated data, not a live search. Not a live rate for one hotel.

city.description: las_vegas (the Strip) or miami (Miami Beach, Brickell, Downtown)

date.description: The night asked, YYYY-MM-DD (the check-in night); null to look up by event

end_date.description: Last night of a stay, YYYY-MM-DD, to list every checked night in between; null for one night

event.description: Event name if the traveller named one (e.g. "re:Invent", "Art Basel"); null otherwise

name: hotel_price_index
title: Hotel price index
